notes: §2002:14.8.18.2 SR1 over the 2002 statement sets: a conditional statement after imperatives is accepted and runs in both positions, CALL ... ON OVERFLOW and RECEIVE ... NO DATA as statement-1 (ended by ELSE) and CALL ... ON OVERFLOW as statement-2 (ended by END-IF). ENABLE, SEND, DISABLE and PURGE are accepted as imperatives. The golden matched at --std 2002.
